name: Blueleaf Tuber
summary: Beneath Razorfen Kraul, Blueleaf Tubers grow hidden from the surface. Their rarity draws wealthy gourmands and traders from across the world.

sections.title: A Rare Underground Delicacy
sections.body: Blueleaf Tubers grow beneath Razorfen Kraul in the Barrens. Dense roots and quilboar briars hide them from casual foragers. Though the ground is harsh, wealthy gourmands and traders across the world pay an exorbitant price for their distinct flavor.

sections.title: Gopher-Assisted Harvesting
sections.body: In Ratchet, the goblin Mebok Mizzyrix devised a way to find the hidden roots. He trains native snufflenose gophers to scent tubers from fifty paces away. Guided by specialized command sticks, adventurers can unearth them before quilboar patrols catch wind of the intrusion.

faq.q: What are Blueleaf Tubers used for?
faq.answer: Wealthy clients and exotic traders pay a premium for Blueleaf Tubers, drawn by their distinct taste and scarcity.

faq.q: Where can Blueleaf Tubers be found?
faq.answer: Blueleaf Tubers grow deep underground in Razorfen Kraul, in the southern Barrens, among its briars and subterranean dens.

faq.q: Why do you need a gopher to dig them up?
faq.answer: Blueleaf Tubers hide beneath the topsoil, beyond the sight of humans and goblins. Trained snufflenose gophers scent them from fifty paces away and dig them up on command.
The goblin entrepreneur Mebok Mizzyrix, based in Ratchet, buys Blueleaf Tubers to sell to wealthy buyers and international contacts for a hefty profit.

angles.text: Blueleaf Tubers are a rare culinary delicacy sought by the wealthiest gourmands, though they grow in the harsh dirt of quilboar dens.
